response.sql: WITH units AS (SELECT s.sentreg, t.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix, s.instownpct AS ownership FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON s.transref = t.transreg WHERE t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL AND s.instownpct IS NOT NULL), mix_baselines AS (SELECT order_type_mix, AVG(ownership) AS baseline FROM units GROUP BY order_type_mix), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ownership) AS baseline FROM units) SELECT AVG(u.ownership) AS avg_kept_ownership, AVG(u.ownership / m.baseline) AS avg_ratio_to_mix_baseline, AVG(u.ownership - o.baseline) AS avg_excess_overall FROM units AS u JOIN mix_baselines AS m ON u.order_type_mix = m.order_type_mix CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE u.ownership > o.baseline
